prompt:

Pose 2: deeply bending knees and torso toward the near-left ground, near hand reaching just in front of the left boot to pick up a small basket.
Pose 3: half risen from that bend, both empty palms supporting an imagined basket at knee/low-waist level.

Use a single consistent drawing scale across the row; crouching must be visibly shorter without changing the size of his head. Feet all rest on a common horizontal baseline. Keep the entire head, boots and extended fingers inside each quarter with generous transparent padding. Exactly four isolated characters, no duplicated extra figures, no text, no labels, no grid lines, no ground or shadows, genuine alpha transparency. Do not modernize his clothes, add a beard, make him bulky, or increase chibi head proportions.
